The '''Eseg power plant''' was a [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]] on [[Delphon/Legends|Delphon]] which suffered a reactor meltdown, forcing the entire facility to be permanently quarantined.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Opportunity Overload}}</ref>
